common.accuracyNotice: Checks cannot be guaranteed to be 100% accurate. Stay careful.

incoming.noLink: There is no link in this text

welcome.title: Welcome to blockAI
welcome.body: blockAI checks links before they open, so you can avoid scams.

how.title: How it works
how.step1: Tap a link in WhatsApp or SMS
how.step3: Safe links open, dangerous links are blocked

protect.title: Turn on protection
protect.body: Make blockAI your main browser app, so every link you tap is checked first.
protect.failed: Protection is not on yet. Choose blockAI as the default browser app in settings.
protect.google: Links are checked with Google Safe Browsing. Only a small code from the link is sent, not the link itself.

protection.activeBody: Links you tap will be checked first
protection.inactiveBody: Turn it on so links from WhatsApp and SMS are checked first

home.notALink: This is not a web link

result.openFailed: No app available to open this link
result.confirmTitle: Are you sure you want to open this suspicious link?
result.confirmBody: Do not enter passwords, PINs, or bank details on this site.

dangerous.title: DANGER – do not open this link
dangerous.socialEngineering: This site is suspected of being deceptive. Attackers may try to steal your passwords, PIN, or bank details.
dangerous.malware: This site may contain code that could harm your phone.
dangerous.unwantedSoftware: This site may contain harmful programs.
dangerous.harmfulApp: This site may try to install harmful apps.

unchecked.title: This link could not be checked
unchecked.body: We cannot confirm that this link is safe.

reason.ipHost: The address is a number (an IP address), not a site name
reason.idnHost: The address uses characters that look like normal letters
reason.brandLookalike: The address imitates an official bank/service name
reason.shortenerUnresolved: A short link whose destination could not be seen
reason.suspiciousTld: The address ending is often used for scams
reason.userinfoInUrl: This address hides the real site
reason.gsbSocialEngineering: Google flags this site as deceptive
reason.gsbMalware: Google flags this site as containing harmful programs
reason.gsbUnwantedSoftware: Google flags this site as containing unwanted software
reason.gsbHarmfulApp: Google flags this site as installing harmful apps
reason.serviceError: The checking service is having problems
reason.noApiKey: The checking service is not configured

history.title: History
history.clearBody: History is stored only on this phone and cannot be restored.

settings.title: Settings
settings.protectionActive: On: blockAI checks the links you tap
